title: Ledger Balance Band for Self-Pay Payoffs, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
The balance band of a self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account reads the account's ledger: its liability postings less its adjustments and payments, plus any refunds issued.

**Clause.** A ledger balance of at least 2000.00 USD adds 1 percentage point to the self-pay payoff discount percent; at least 500.00 but below 2000.00 adds 0.5 percentage points; less adds none.

| Ledger balance | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| at least 2000.00 | 1 |
| at least 500.00, below 2000.00 | 0.5 |
| below 500.00 | none |

## Worked figure (hypothetical ledger)

| Ledger entry | Amount |
|---|---|
| Liability postings | 3000.00 |
| less adjustments | 1350.00 |
| less payments | 200.00 |
| plus refunds issued | 50.00 |
| Ledger balance | 1500.00 |

A ledger balance of 1500.00 adds 0.5 points; 2000.00 would add 1 point, and 499.99 none.
